pallet-display.context: A wooden pallet seen from the front with a pyramid of boxes stacked on it. Used for bulk promotions, warehouse club aisles and seasonal stack displays.

aisle-marker-sign.context: A rectangular sign hanging from two wires with a large number on it. Used for supermarket aisle numbers, store maps and wayfinding.

window-display.context: A storefront window frame with a dressed mannequin and a small price tag inside the glass. Used for shop front merchandising and visual display jobs.

gondola-shelving.context: A freestanding shelf unit seen from the end with shelves on both sides of a central upright panel. Used for supermarket aisles and store layout planning.

slatwall-panel.context: A wall panel of evenly spaced horizontal grooves with two hooks and a small shelf fixed in the slots. Used for flexible wall merchandising in shops and garages.

peg-hook-display.context: A pegboard square with two long straight hooks holding hanging blister packs. Used for small hardware, accessories and impulse products in stores.

hat-display-stand.context: A tall pole stand with three round caps on short arms at different heights. Used in hat shops and accessory sections.

eyewear-display-tower.context: A narrow vertical tower with pairs of glasses resting on small ledges one above another. Used by opticians and sunglass sellers.

ring-display-tray.context: A shallow rectangular tray with slots and three rings standing in them. Used in jewellery shops and market stalls.

watch-display-cushion.context: A small oval pillow with a watch strap wrapped around it and the dial on top. Used for watch retail and jewellery counters.

earring-card.context: A small card with a hanging hole at the top and a pair of stud earrings pushed through it. Used for packaged jewellery in shops and craft markets.

mannequin-hand.context: An upright hand shaped display form on a round base with a ring on one finger. Used to show rings and gloves in shops.

glass-door-cooler.context: An upright refrigerator with a full glass door, shelves of bottles and a handle bar. Used for chilled drinks in convenience stores.

open-display-chiller.context: A tall open front refrigerated case with stepped shelves of packs and a curtain line at the top. Used for dairy and ready meals in supermarkets.

deli-counter.context: A curved glass front counter with trays of sliced meat inside and a scale on top. Used for delicatessen and fresh food service areas.

gravity-bin-dispenser.context: A clear vertical bin mounted on a wall with a lever handle at the bottom above a chute. Used for dry goods such as cereal, nuts and grains.

pick-and-mix-bins.context: A row of three clear bins with propped lids and sweets inside, with a scoop hanging below. Used for self serve sweet shops and cinema counters.

live-seafood-tank.context: A glass tank with a lobster at the bottom, rising bubbles and a wavy waterline. Used for fishmongers, restaurants and fresh seafood sections.

flower-bucket-stand.context: A tiered stand with three buckets on steps, each holding bunches of flowers. Used for florists and street flower stalls.

paint-chip-rack.context: A wall rack with rows of narrow colour strip cards, each strip showing three shade blocks. Used in paint departments and decorating stores.

lumber-rack.context: A tall metal rack with long boards resting horizontally on cantilever arms. Used for timber yards and home improvement stores.

rope-spool-rack.context: A frame holding three large spools of rope on a horizontal bar with the ends hanging down. Used for cut to length rope sales in hardware and marine shops.

seed-packet-display.context: A small rack with rows of pockets each holding a seed packet showing a flower picture. Used in garden centres and farm shops.

greeting-card-rack.context: A tiered rack with rows of folded greeting cards standing upright in pockets. Used in stationery and card shops.

clip-strip-display.context: A long vertical plastic strip with small snack bags clipped one below another and a hook at the top. Used for impulse snacks near checkouts.

nail-polish-display.context: A stepped acrylic rack with three rows of small nail polish bottles. Used in beauty shops and salons selling polish.

shirt-folding-board.context: A flat hinged board with three folding panels and a folded shirt outline beside it. Used by clothing store staff to fold shirts evenly.

waterfall-display-arm.context: A sloped bar sticking out of a wall panel with knobs along it and two hangers hooked on. Used to hang clothes in a cascading line.

floor-shoe-mirror.context: A small low mirror tilted upward on the floor with a shoe standing beside it. Used in shoe shops so customers can see shoes on their feet.

makeup-tester-display.context: A sloped counter tray holding lipsticks and round compacts with a small mirror at the back. Used in cosmetics departments for trying shades.

merchandise-table.context: A low table with piles of folded shirts and a small sign stand on the corner. Used for promotional tables in clothing stores.

folded-shirt-stack.context: A stack of four neatly folded T-shirts seen from the front with collars showing on top. Used for apparel shelves and laundry themes.

ball-cage-display.context: A wire mesh cage bin on the floor with sports balls poking above the rim. Used in sporting goods stores.

listening-station.context: A pair of headphones hanging on a stand with a small screen and a play button below. Used in music stores to sample records and tracks.

can-pyramid-display.context: A pyramid of stacked cans with four on the bottom row rising to one on top. Used for grocery promotions and end aisle displays.

acrylic-display-riser.context: Three clear stepped blocks of different heights with a small product on each step. Used on counters to lift and show products.

acrylic-sign-holder.context: A clear stand holding an upright card with lines of text on a counter. Used for prices, menus and notices on tables and counters.

poster-floor-stand.context: A poster frame on a single post standing on a heavy round base. Used for promotions and advertising in store entrances.

phone-display-tether.context: A smartphone standing on a small puck base joined by a coiled security cable. Used for demo phones in electronics shops.

hosiery-leg-form.context: A leg shaped display form with a stocking band and a hanging loop at the thigh. Used to show tights, socks and stockings in shops.

checkout-impulse-rack.context: A small rack of bins holding candy bars and gum, drawn beside the edge of a checkout counter. Used for last minute purchases at tills.

rug-flip-rack.context: A wall mounted rack with hinged arms that fan out, each draped with a hanging rug. Used for carpet and home furnishing displays.

tag-detacher.context: A dome shaped detacher fixed on a counter with a round security tag on top. Used by cashiers to remove anti theft tags after payment.

ice-merchandiser.context: A chest style outdoor freezer with a lid line and a snowflake on its front. Used for bagged ice sales outside convenience stores and petrol stations.

paint-shaker.context: A boxy machine with a paint can clamped between two plates and motion lines on each side. Used in hardware stores to mix paint.

propane-exchange-cage.context: A mesh cage holding two rows of gas cylinders. Used for cylinder swap and refill points outside shops.

bread-slicer.context: A slicing machine with a loaf in the front slot and vertical blades above it. Used in bakeries and supermarket bakery sections.

fitting-room-tag.context: A plastic tag with an arched hanging loop and a large number 3 on its face. Used to count garments taken into changing rooms.

shoe-fitting-stool.context: A low stool seen from the side with a sloped foot rest ramp on its front edge. Used in shoe stores for trying on footwear.

hanger-size-divider.context: A round disc with a slot to its centre hanging on a rail and marked with the letter M. Used to separate clothing sizes on rails.

electronic-shelf-label.context: A small digital price label clipped to a shelf edge showing a price line and a tiny barcode. Used for dynamic pricing in supermarkets.

price-check-kiosk.context: A small wall mounted screen with a scanner window below and a beam line under it. Used so shoppers can scan an item to see its price.

bag-carousel.context: A rotating stand with three shopping bags hanging open on arms around a central post. Used at checkouts for carrier bags.

boutique-bag.context: A stiff rectangular shopping bag with a looped rope handle and a folded top edge. Used for gift bags, luxury purchases and shop packaging.

u-boat-stocking-cart.context: A long narrow flat cart with upturned ends and boxes stacked in the middle. Used by store staff to restock shelves.

cart-wipes-dispenser.context: An upright canister of cart wipes with one wipe pulled up and a small bin at its base. Used at supermarket entrances to clean trolley handles.

produce-bag-dispenser.context: A roll of thin plastic bags on a bar with one bag hanging down by a torn edge. Used in fruit and vegetable sections.

chalkboard-price-card.context: A small chalkboard sign on a spike pushed into a pile of apples with a price dash. Used at farm stands and market stalls.

store-hours-sign.context: A door sign hanging from a string with a clock face above a line of opening times. Used on shop doors to show when a business is open.

self-order-kiosk.context: A tall slim kiosk with a touch screen showing a grid of tiles and a card slot below. Used for ordering food and paying without staff.

customer-service-desk.context: A counter desk with a round question mark sign above it. Used for help desks, returns and information points in shops.

antique-cash-register.context: An old fashioned cash register with a number flag on top, keys and a drawer. Used for vintage shops, retro themes and sales.

inventory-handheld.context: A rugged handheld scanner computer with a screen, keys and a beam from its top edge. Used for stock takes and receiving goods.

cart-escalator.context: An inclined moving walkway strip with a shopping cart riding up it at an angle. Used for multi floor stores and malls.

smart-shopping-cart.context: A shopping cart with a small screen above the handle and a scan beam from the screen. Used for scan and go shopping.

kids-shopping-cart.context: A small child sized shopping cart with a tall flag on a pole at the back. Used for family friendly stores and toy shops.

wheelchair-shopping-cart.context: A side view wheelchair with a shopping basket frame attached to its front. Used for accessibility notices in shops.

produce-plu-sticker.context: An apple with a small oval sticker on its side showing a product number. Used for produce labelling and price lookup codes.

bulk-refill-dispenser.context: A row of three wall dispensers with a glass jar underneath the middle nozzle. Used for zero waste refill shops.

photo-kiosk.context: A kiosk with a touch screen showing a picture and a printed photo coming out of the slot below. Used for printing photos in shops.

movie-rental-kiosk.context: A kiosk with a screen and a disc dropping out of the slot below it. Used for renting films from vending units.

windowed-box-packaging.context: A product box with a clear cut out window on the front showing a small toy inside. Used for toy and gadget packaging.

refurbished-item.context: A box marked with two circling arrows to show a restored and renewed product. Used for renewed or recycled goods listings.

return-authorization.context: A form with two text lines and a large return arrow turning back beside it. Used for return merchandise requests and refund slips.

footfall-counter.context: A door frame with a sensor box above it and a person walking through. Used for counting visitors entering a shop.

shoplifting.context: A jacket with a collar and a pocket with a small box being slipped into it. Used for retail theft and loss prevention topics.

mystery-shopper.context: A person in a brimmed hat and sunglasses standing next to a shopping bag. Used for secret shopper audits and customer experience checks.

price-history.context: A price tag with a small zigzag line chart drawn across its face. Used for price tracking, deal alerts and trend views.

handmade-goods.context: A knitted beanie with a pom-pom and a small stitched heart on the front. Used for craft fairs, artisan shops and handmade marketplaces.
